text:
zoe (Design): Quick flag  users keep opening tickets when SSO is on: they try to pick a role in the invite modal but the dropdown is disabled and the label says "SSO enforced". Feels like we're hiding the why.
mike (PM): saw 3 cases this week. Need clearer inline affordance and a path to provisioning.
sara (FE): technical note: disabled selects are not tabbable; keyboard users miss the explanation. Suggest replacing select with a read-only row + an inline help pill that expands in place. Cheap to implement.
leo (A11y): agree  make the pill a button with aria-expanded and role=region for the content. If we open a dialog, use aria-modal and aria-labelledby. Also ensure contrast for the pill text.
zoe (Design): copy for collapsed pill: "Managed by SSO". Expanded heading: "How SSO assigns roles" body: "Your identity provider controls role assignments. To change defaults, update provisioning in your IdP." Link: "Open provisioning settings". Keep it short.
mike (PM): and when users click a role's "View audit" from the roles matrix, preserve context: deep-link to /audit?role={slug} and show a small banner "Showing events for: {Role}" so users don't have to re-filter.
sara (FE): plan: 1) hotfix: swap disabled select for readonly row + pill; 2) add ?role=slug handling on audit page and banner; 3) follow-up: small drawer preview for recent events. Will ensure we use slugs not internal UUIDs.
leo (A11y): banner should have aria-live="polite" when applied via deep-link. For the pill: Esc collapses, Enter expands, focus moves into region. I'll run a keyboard-only pass on staging.
staging-bot: preview build deployed to staging at 2026-03-29T10:05Z (branch fix/invite-sso-help-pill) :white_check_mark:
mike (PM): acceptance criteria: pill present and accessible, audit deep-link banner works, no sensitive info in URLs, link opens provisioning in new tab with toast. Target: hotfix this sprint.
zoe (Design): I'll drop updated mocks and final microcopy into the ticket. Thanks team!
